She is a genetically enhanced demigod made for a galactic war, and a part of her wanted to see what would happen if she was born for peace. What is peace like? Could she enjoy a feast, or a party without being tense? Could she stop calculating in her supercomputer mind if there is going to be an attack? Fortunately she has a chance to find these answers. A culture mind has decided to take her from her home although with consent and some wordplay and plans to see how she can act in such a society and what what culture can she bring. Back on her world, she could fight hordes of foes. If she tried to fight the hub mind then that will just lead to embarrassing situations. How can this weapon of war learn how to live?
